newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Keegan to aquire Knox, Wall & Co.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Keegan to aquire Knox, Wall & Co.

text.p: Morgan Keegan Inc said Tuesday it had an agreement in principle to acquire Knox, Wall & Co., a municipal bond firm based in Atlanta.
Terms were not disclosed. The deal is expected to be completed by Aug. 1.
The agreement calls for Knox, Wall to operate as a division of Morgan Keegan & Co. Inc, the brokerage subsidiary of Morgan Keegan Inc.

"In addition to continuing current banking, trading, underwriting and sales activities, Knox, Wall will now be able to provide our clients with enhanced products and services as a result of our affiliation with Morgan Keegan," Knox, Wall President Ed Wall said.
Knox, Wall, formerly known as W. L. Knox & Co., serves clients in Georgia and Florida and was founded in 1974. It employs 19 people and will continue to operate from its office in Atlanta.
Morgan Keegan Inc is based in Atlanta and one of the South's largest investment firms with 38 offices in 12 states.
"The addition of Knox, Wall & Company will significantly enhance our presence in this part of the region," said David Ramsey, Morgan Keegan managing director and head of fixed income.
